Configuring TLS in nginx

Put the certificate chain and the private key where nginx can read them, then add a
server block that listens on 443 with ssl:

    server {
        listen 443 ssl;
        http2 on;
        server_name example.com;
        ssl_certificate     /etc/ssl/example.com/fullchain.pem;
        ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/example.com/privkey.pem;
        ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
        ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:10m;
    }

Redirect plain HTTP with a second server block that returns 301 to https. Test the
configuration with nginx -t before reloading with nginx -s reload.
